title: Generate and derive remote keys
responsibility: Create P-256 key pairs, validate imported pairs and derive shared secrets and AES keys.

inputs.name: sharedSecret.privateKey
inputs.description: Private CryptoKey passed to ECDH deriveBits. The implementation does not precheck its curve or usage, so Web Crypto determines whether it can be used.

inputs.name: sharedSecret.publicKey
inputs.description: Peer public key as a raw uncompressed P-256 point. The wrapper requires exactly 65 bytes beginning with 0x04, then delegates point validity to Web Crypto.

inputs.name: importRemoteKeys.stored
inputs.description: Stored private scalar d and base64url-encoded public point used to reconstruct a P-256 key pair. The decoded point must pass the 65-byte uncompressed-point check, and the ECDH probe rejects halves that do not match.

inputs.name: exportRemoteKeys.pair
inputs.description: Key pair whose private key is exported as JWK and whose publicKey bytes are encoded as base64url. The helper checks for a string d in the exported JWK but does not persist or cross-check the pair.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.ikm
inputs.description: Input key material imported as the raw key for HKDF. The helper passes these bytes to Web Crypto without separate length validation.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.salt
inputs.description: Salt bytes passed to the HKDF parameters. The helper does not transform or validate the salt itself.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.info
inputs.description: HKDF context supplied as bytes or text. Text is converted through remoteBytes before derivation, while byte input is passed through.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.length
inputs.description: Requested output length in bytes, multiplied by eight before calling deriveBits. The helper does not prevalidate the range, so Web Crypto determines whether the bit length is accepted.

inputs.name: aesKey.bytes
inputs.description: Raw bytes imported as a nonextractable AES-GCM key with encrypt and decrypt usages. The helper is documented for AES-256-GCM and does not perform its own key-length check.

outputs.name: remoteKeys
outputs.description: Fresh ECDH P-256 key pair containing raw public-key bytes and a private CryptoKey. The generated pair is extractable and the private key has deriveBits usage.

outputs.name: sharedSecret
outputs.description: The 32-byte x coordinate produced by ECDH for the supplied private key and peer public point. The point must pass the wrapper's uncompressed-point shape check and be usable by Web Crypto.

outputs.name: importRemoteKeys
outputs.description: Imported P-256 key pair returned after an ECDH probe confirms that its private scalar and stored public point agree. Mismatched halves are rejected.

outputs.name: exportRemoteKeys
outputs.description: Object containing the private JWK d string and the public bytes encoded as base64url. This helper returns the data without persisting it.

outputs.name: deriveBytes
outputs.description: Bytes derived with HKDF-SHA256 from the supplied IKM, salt, and info. The output length is the requested byte count passed to deriveBits as bits.

outputs.name: aesKey
outputs.description: Nonextractable AES-GCM CryptoKey with encrypt and decrypt usages. The helper is documented as AES-256-GCM.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An explicit Error is thrown when a public point fails the length or prefix check, an imported private scalar does not match its public point, or exported JWK data has no string d. Other Web Crypto rejections propagate without being normalized by these helpers.

outputs.description: Fresh ECDH P-256 key pair containing raw public-key bytes and a private CryptoKey. The generated pair is extractable and the private key has deriveBits usage.

errors.description: Thrown when exporting the private key yields JWK data without a string d. Web Crypto export rejections propagate directly.
